description_expanded:
WaterColor, steps from Dragonfly Pool!

Access to Camp Watercolor and Watercolor Beach Club

Community pools, seasonally heated

5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths

4-seater golf cart

5 Bikes

Quaint outdoor areas, screened in porch, and balcony with swing bed

Gas grill

Emerald Pearl by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 A stone’s toss from Dragonfly Pool and minutes from Camp WaterColor, this designer five-bedroom retreat brings comfort, style, and all the thoughtful touches that make a vacation feel effortless. Roll around the community in the complimentary 4-seater golf cart, hop on one of the five bikes for a spin to the beach, pool hopping, coffee pickups, or spontaneous detours. Guests have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club, now featuring a trio of pools, generous lounge areas, an elevated grill, and a sunset bar called Costa Chica, all set against wide Gulf views. Inside, the main level sets an easy rhythm with generous gathering space, a dry bar stocked with a wine fridge and ice maker, and a chef-friendly kitchen with premium appliances and a large island built for conversation. Dark hardwood floors and white shiplap keep things crisp and coastal. A serene primary suite, king, sits on this level with a spa-style bathroom, along with a convenient powder room. Head upstairs for four more bedrooms and a second living area perfect for movie nights, games, or that essential post-beach power-down. Sleeping options include a primary suite with a private balcony, king, a guest room, king, a guest room, queen, and a twin-over-full bunkroom. Outside, the spacious screened porch invites everyone to settle in with cushy seating and quiet neighborhood views. The swinging porch bed is a crowd favorite for book-before-nap moments and late-night chats. 68 E Royal Fern delivers style and laid-back ease in a coveted WaterColor location.

Bring your crew and make it yours for the week. For added comfort, Oversee 30A is close by. Our local team is available every day, and a 24/7 emergency line is always on standby, just in case the unexpected decides to visit. Overview: - 1.6 miles to the beach (Beach Club private access) - .4 miles to the public beach access - 1.1 miles to Seaside - Access to five WaterColor resort-style pools - 5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths - Complimentary 4-seater golf cart (LSV) and 5 bikes - Open and well-equipped chef's kitchen with wine fridge/ice maker - Screened-in outdoor living space with swinging porch bed - Dining for six with breakfast bar seating for four - Outdoor shower - Gas grill *Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands. Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: King bed, shared bathroom, shower, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bathroom, shower, Private Balcony, TV - Guest Bedroom: King bed, shared bathroom, shower, TV - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, shared bathroom, shower, TV - Guest Bedroom: Twin over Full Bunk Bed, Shared bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Living Room: Queen sleeper sofa Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST
